parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query, in ISO 8601 format. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: Granularity
parameters.description:
The time granularity for the query. Valid values:

- DAY

- MONTH

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query, in ISO 8601 format. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
